why: A bare call in a package file never reaches the package's own function of the name (only an import does), so `size(x, 1)` inside `+util/size.m` is the built-in: no self edge, and the row kept dormant (MATLAB doc 'Packages Create Namespaces'; harvested from matlab-resolution.test.ts 'never resolves a bare call in a package file to the package function itself').
